title: 第十二章 孤儿院第十三章 诡菩萨
content_zh:
再睁开眼睛时，依旧是保安室。
这个剧本每次转变昼夜时似乎都会固定切换到保安室里，周游转头看了一眼钟表。
——看起来时间也是固定的。
和上回到来时一样，保安室里依旧空无一人，他穿的也同样是那件崭新的保安服，只是比起上次来讲这里倒是乱上了很多。
或者说......不止很多。
桌椅之类的东西都被掀翻到了一边，日志与档案之类的散落得到处都是，甚至那早就坏掉的电视都摔落到了地方，连屏幕都被砸了个粉碎。
周游在这一堆杂物里找了一圈，然后自言自语道。
“看起来.....不太像是抢劫一样的入侵，而是有人想在这保安室里找一些什么东西，至于他找没找到嘛......”
周游转过脑袋，看了一眼旁边明显是因为泄愤而杂碎的两个花瓶。
“看样子应该是没找到，但问题又来了，这一个破保安室里有啥需要这扫荡一样搜索的呢.....”
周游同样仔细搜索一圈，但和入侵者一样，他也没踅摸到什么线索——这么一个小保安室随随便便就能一览而尽，单薄的墙壁和地板间也不像是有什么能藏东西的空间，所以最后他也只能摇摇头，然后就此走了出去。
——毕竟白天的时间有限，他必须精打细算。
外头的景色和前一天也差不多，唯一值得一提的是雾气更加浓了一些，如果前段时间他还能看到行人模样的话，现在已经只能见到些许模糊不清的人影。
“——但影响不大，毕竟这帮人也没法沟通。”
在这乳白色的雾气中，周游就这么顺着熟悉的巡逻路线前行，大约是晚上连过两关的原因，他白天可以行动的范围居然也随之扩大的很多，之前的元顺路口不再有迷雾阻隔，很轻松的就能走过当时摆摊的地点，然后来到了那个‘玩游戏’的胡同之前。
但在这里，他却停住了脚步。
和夜晚那遐迩一体的景色不同，此时此刻，就在那漆黑的胡同旁，居然像是凭空出现一样，突然多了一个奇特的建筑。
从外观来看，这建筑物是个独栋，占地并不算小但也说不上多大，大概在两三百平方米最优，房子整体是个两层建筑，砖石结构，在最顶上还能见到个破破烂烂的招牌。
“天使之家”
但现在这屋子就像是遭了火灾一样，整体都被熏成了漆黑之色，一眼望去还能见到不少塌陷的地方，大概是为了防止某些闲人勿扰而出现什么事故，在建筑外围还围了一圈铁质的栏杆。

“这玩意......就是那小鬼歌谣中的孤儿院了吧？”周游随意扫了一眼，感觉没什么可用的东西——毕竟他那游戏都通关了，也不需要在这里再找线索——刚想就此离开，但突然间，他却感觉到了些许的违和。
下一刻，他缓缓蹲了下去，在栏杆地下抓起一把土，轻轻碾了碾。
——土壤内层的湿气仍然未散，从潮湿程度来看，这些栏杆才竖起了不到半天....不，应该是几个小时前才刚刚立起来的。
于是周游露出了一个饶有兴趣的表情。
“但问题是这么一个失火废弃已久的建筑，为什么到现在才想起来围上禁止他人进入？”
content_en:
When I opened my eyes again, it was still the security room.
This script seems to always switch to the security room every time day and night change. Zhou You turns his head and glances at the clock.
——It seems that time is also fixed.
Just like when he came back last time, the security room was still empty. He was also wearing the same brand-new security uniform, but it was a lot messier than last time.
Or...more than a lot.
Things like tables and chairs were overturned to the side, logs and files were scattered everywhere, and even the TV that broke long ago fell to the ground, and even the screen was smashed to pieces.
Zhou You searched around in this pile of clutter, and then said to himself.
"It doesn't look like an invasion like robbery, but someone is looking for something in this security room. As for whether he found it or not..."
Zhou You turned his head and glanced at the two vases next to him that were obviously broken out of anger.
"It seems like they haven't been found, but the question arises again. Is there anything in this shabby security room that needs to be searched like this?"
Zhou You also searched carefully, but like the intruder, he couldn't find any clues - such a small security room could be easily seen at a glance, and there didn't seem to be any space to hide things between the thin walls and floors, so in the end he could only shake his head and walked out.
——After all, the time during the day is limited, and he must budget carefully.
The scenery outside was similar to the day before. The only thing worth mentioning was that the fog was thicker. If he could still see the appearance of pedestrians some time ago, now he could only see some blurry figures.
"——But it won't have much impact. After all, these people can't communicate."
In this milky white mist, Zhou You just followed the familiar patrol route. Probably because he passed two levels at night, the range of actions he could take during the day was actually expanded a lot. The previous Yuanshun intersection was no longer blocked by fog, and he could easily walk past the place where the stall was set up, and then came to the alley where he was playing games.
But here, he stopped.
Different from the distant and distant scenery at night, at this moment, next to the dark alley, a strange building suddenly appeared out of thin air.
Judging from the appearance, this building is a single-family building. It occupies a small area but cannot say how big it is. It is about two to three hundred square meters. The overall house is a two-story building with a masonry structure. There is a tattered signboard on the top.
"Angel's House"
But now the house seems to have been hit by a fire. The whole house has been turned into a pitch black color. At a glance, you can see a lot of collapsed places. Probably to prevent accidents caused by some idlers, there is also a circle of iron railings around the outside of the building.
"This thing...is the orphanage in the little devil's ballad, right?" Zhou You glanced at it casually, feeling that there was nothing useful - after all, he had cleared the game, and there was no need to look for clues here - he was about to leave, but suddenly, he felt a little inconsistent.
The next moment, he slowly squatted down, grabbed a handful of soil under the railing, and crushed it gently.
——The moisture in the inner layer of the soil is still there. Judging from the moisture level, these railings have only been erected for less than half a day... No, they should have been erected just a few hours ago.
So Zhou You showed an interested expression.
“But the question is, why is it only now that I think of surrounding a building that has been abandoned for a long time due to fire and prohibiting others from entering?”
